BREAKFAST 10
Bread, ricotta, and honey tasting
A simple breakfast becomes a journey through flavors.
TIME
5 minutes
DIFFICULTY
Very easy
SERVES
1-2 people
INGREDIENTS PREPARE IT THIS WAY
Rustic or whole grain bread
Butter or fresh ricotta
2 or 3 different honeys
Fresh fruit of your choice
01 Slice and lightly toast the bread.
02 Prepare small portions of butter or
ricotta.
03 Taste one honey at a time, starting with the
most delicate.
RECOMMENDED HONEY
Your favorite
Start with Acacia, continue with Wildflower, and finish with
Chestnut.

A LITTLE GAME
What kind of honey are you this morning?
Choose A, B, C or D. At the end, count the letter you indicated most often.
1 · TODAY YOU DESIRE...
A Gentle sweetness B A familiar flavor
C Something bold D A cheerful aroma
2 · WHAT WOULD YOU SERVE?
A Yogurt or ricotta B Bread or granola
C Warm porridge D Fruit or pancakes
3 · YOUR IDEAL MORNING IS...
A Bright and calm B Simple and serene
C Slow and intense D Colorful and lively
4 · IN YOUR BOWL YOU SEEK...
A Delicacy B Balance
C Character D A fruity note
The result is on the next page.
